chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a man who has Dinars upon him. He said: There is no problem if he takes their value in Dirhams.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to exchange gold dinars for silver dirhams in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the permissibility of exchanging gold dinars for silver dirhams based on current market value, addressing the practical needs of individuals managing debt or assets. It reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of *bay' al-dinār bi al-dirham* as a valid transaction when the exchange is based on prevailing valuation rather than fixed nominal amounts, ensuring fairness in monetary dealings.
